node.title: Prize N=256 square-mass-18 cofactor-2 exclusion
node.statement: On prize-envelope N=256 rows, profile-(4,2,0) cofactor 2 is impossible. Dual complete normalized streams leave 511272 vectors after the high-variance exclusion. FLINT and PARI agree through a 64-bucket multiset fingerprint, and every quotient Norm/2 lies strictly outside the prize interval.
node.notes: EXACT FINITE EXCLUSION 2026-07-28: dual streamed enumeration and exact arithmetic eliminate the last prize cofactor of the leading square-mass-18 profile. Later profiles and the aggregate weighted pair budget remain open.
